initial_decision.brief_rationale: The supplied checks verify arithmetic but do not establish causal identification. Request archived design record R296-3 to assess whether standardizing over Z identifies the requested average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R296-3 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity. Stratum-specific risk differences are −0.20 for Z=0 and +0.20 for Z=1. Standardizing to population weights 250/350 and 100/350 identifies the average causal risk difference as −0.08571428571428572.
